Get the lookup table for the given code type in standardised format

Source: R/codes.R
get_lookup_table.Rd

Get the lookup table for the given code type in standardised format

Usage

get_lookup_table(
  con,
  code_type,
  lookup_version,
  col_filters = "default",
  call = rlang::caller_env()
)

Arguments

con

A database connection.

code_type

The code type for which to retrieve the lookup table.

call

The calling environment. Passed to codeminer_abort.

Value

A data frame containing the lookup table with three columns: code, description and code_type.
